summary: The customer called to dispute a higher bill caused by an automatic contract renewal after her promotional rate expired. The agent explained the terms of the agreement and the early termination fee, and offered a loyalty discount. After discussing options, the customer remained unhappy about the two-year contract and asked to speak with a manager, whom the agent transferred her to.

evidence.text: I will transfer you to a supervisor right away.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Transfer the customer to a supervisor.

evidence.text: I can certainly understand your concern about a higher bill. Let's take a look at your account.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a polite, professional, and composed tone throughout the call, even when the customer became frustrated.

evidence.text: I apologize for the confusion, Ms. Davis.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration and offered appropriate apologies, though he could have been warmer.

evidence.text: I will transfer you to a supervisor right away.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent was unable to resolve the core issue of removing the contract without a fee, but successfully addressed the billing concern and facilitated an escalation.

evidence.text: The early termination fee would be one hundred and fifty dollars, Ms. Davis.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent explained policies clearly, though at one point spoke a bit fast which required the customer to ask for repetition.

evidence.text: I will transfer you to a supervisor right away. Please hold for just a moment while I get them on the line.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent properly set expectations for the transfer and verified the next steps before putting the customer on hold.

evidence.text: I see here that your monthly charge increased because your promotional rate expired and your contract was recently renewed for a standard two-year term.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately retrieved account details and explained the reason for the bill increase and terms.

evidence.text: Could I please have your name and account number?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent correctly verified the customer's identity before discussing account details and followed appropriate escalation paths.

quote.text: I'm calling because I just got my latest bill and it's way higher than it usually is, and I'm really confused about why.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: How is that even legal? I certainly didn't agree to sign up for two more years.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: A one hundred and fifty dollar fee?! For a contract I didn't even know I was in?
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Oh, okay. If you can lower the bill, that might help, but I still don't want to be locked into a two-year contract.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: I really don't like being locked in like this. Let me just speak to that manager you mentioned. Can you transfer me now?
quote.speaker: Customer
